manifest.name: dsh-todo-list
manifest.description: A lightweight, local TODO list that lives in the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar.

bundle.text:
# dsh-todo-list — bundle patch.
#
# One row only: the plugin itself. It contributes client-side UI, so there is no
# host-side wiring beyond this insert.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-todo-list
      name: 'dsh-todo-list'

readme.text:
> DeepSeek Harness 右侧边栏里的轻量待办清单 —— 纯客户端 UI，不进会话上下文，不给模型注册任何工具。

A tiny, local-first TODO list that lives as a native tab in the DeepSeek Harness
right sidebar. Pure client UI: no model-facing tools, nothing added to the
conversation, and every task stays in your browser.

---

- **右侧边栏面板**：在右栏的 `+` 菜单里出现「待办清单」，也可以直接点会话头部的小勾按钮打开。
- **添加 / 完成 / 删除**：回车或点 `+` 添加；点击左侧方框标记完成；悬停行尾出现删除按钮；底部可一键「清除已完成」。
- **平滑拖动排序**：按住任意一行上下拖动，其余行跟随位移，松手落位；拖动到列表上下边缘会自动滚动。
- **本地持久化**：数据写在 `localStorage`（键名 `dsh-todo-list.v1`），刷新、重启、换会话都不会丢；多个窗口之间自动同步。
- **贴合主题**：配色、边框、字号全部取自 DSH 的 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题变量，深浅色主题自动跟随；文案走 locale 服务（中 / 英）。

readme.section: 或者本地源码目录（开发时）
readme.text:
dsh plugin add /path/to/dsh-todo-list
```

安装后刷新页面（或重启桌面端）即可在右侧边栏看到。

1. 会话页面右上角点「勾」图标 —— 或者打开右侧边栏，点 `+`，选择「待办清单」。
2. 在输入框写下任务，回车添加。
3. 拖动行调整顺序，松手即保存。

- 只保存在本机浏览器，不上传、不写文件、不发送给模型。
- 清除方式：删除任务，或在浏览器开发者工具里清掉 `dsh-todo-list.v1`。

---

- **Right-sidebar panel** — shows up as “TODO list” in the right column's `+` menu,
  and can be opened from the small check button in the conversation header.
- **Add / complete / delete** — type and press Enter; click the box to complete;
  hover a row for the delete button; “Clear completed” in the footer.
- **Smooth drag reordering** — grab any row, the others glide out of the way;
  the list auto-scrolls near its edges.
- **Local persistence** — stored in `localStorage` under `dsh-todo-list.v1`,
  surviving reloads, restarts and session switches; synced across windows.
- **Theme native** — every colour comes from the `--dsw-alias-*` tokens, so light
  and dark themes just work; strings go through the locale service (zh / en).

```bash
dsh plugin add github:Minajka/dsh-todo-list
```

Then reload the page (or restart the desktop app).

- No build step, no dependencies, no install scripts: the plugin is plain
  JavaScript, so installing from GitHub works without an allowlisted `prepare`.
- No model-facing tools are registered — this is UI only.

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | DSH bundle manifest (`dsh.bundle` + `dsh.client`) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | one bundle row, inserting the plugin |
| `index.js` | host half: deliberately empty |
| `client.js` | the whole plugin: tab type, panel component, store, styles |
| `locale/*.json` | display metadata (title / description) |
| `icon.svg` | original artwork |
